systems.system: Cybersecurity Hub incident reporting (web form and e-mail)
systems.owner: Cybersecurity Hub, the national CSIRT under the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
systems.tiers: national; the public and businesses report cyber incidents, and those concerning cybercrime or cyberbullying are routed to SAPS for resolution

note: The national CSIRT's reporting channel, which is not a police system; it routes cybercrime reports to SAPS and says nothing of how SAPS records them.
